## connectome-weights (`weights.parquet`)
Columns: `body_pre` (int64), `body_post` (int64), `weight` (int64)

`weight` = number of synaptic contacts (pre→post) at min confidence 0.5. One row per (body_pre, body_post) pair; no duplicate pairs.
